summary.headline: AMD bets $5B on Anthropic as compute race accelerates
summary.body: A day of huge compute deals. AMD committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic, which will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, and OpenAI unveiled 'Project Camellia', a 3.2-gigawatt data-center campus in Georgia. Both raised Capability Velocity, which lifts the endings that need very capable AI: Enslaved God, Descendants and Zookeeper. The AMD deal also concentrates power with a leading lab, adding to Enslaved God and Zookeeper. Faster progress pushes Reversion down. Elsewhere, the White House accused Moonshot of distilling Anthropic's model and evading chip curbs, a small blow to Global Coordination. Mistral signed an Azure deal to grow European compute, and Monday.com cut about 20% of staff in an AI-linked restructuring. Horizon Balance slipped to -1.68.
summary.movers_note: Enslaved God +0.6 came from the AMD-Anthropic deal (+0.38) and Project Camellia (+0.23); Reversion -0.5 and Descendants +0.5 split evenly between the same two stories (-0.23/+0.23 each).
coming_up: OpenAI's Project Camellia campus in Georgia to have power phased in from 2028 to 2032

events.title: White House accuses Moonshot of distilling Anthropic's model and evading chip curbs
events.summary: OSTP Director Michael Kratsios alleged Moonshot AI distilled Anthropic's Fable to build Kimi K3 and accessed Nvidia GB300s via Thailand; Moonshot did not concede.
events.reason: Escalates US-China AI rivalry rhetoric; accusation only.

events.title: AMD to invest up to $5B in Anthropic with 2 GW of MI450 GPUs
events.summary: AMD committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic, which will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs in Helios racks.
events.reason: Giant compute deal for a frontier lab.

events.title: OpenAI announces 3.2 GW 'Project Camellia' data center in Georgia
events.summary: OpenAI unveiled a 1,400-acre, 3.2-gigawatt campus in Effingham County, Georgia, with power phased in 2028-2032 and reported spending of $20-30 billion.

events.title: Mistral signs multibillion-dollar Azure deal to expand European AI infrastructure
events.summary: France's Mistral AI and Microsoft agreed a deal bringing Mistral models to Azure and expanding compute in Europe; Mistral targets 1 GW by 2030.
events.reason: Strengthens a European alternative to US frontier labs.

events.title: Monday.com cuts about 20% of staff, tying restructuring to AI strategy
events.summary: Israel-based Monday.com cut roughly 600 jobs (about 350 in Israel) under an 'AI-driven growth strategy'.
events.reason: Company cites AI in sizeable layoffs.
